config.label: Base URL of the three
config.description: Base URL of the three.ws API that serves the vision endpoint. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.

config.label: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for the vision call (the VLM may chain across free lanes before answering)
config.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for the vision call (the VLM may chain across free lanes before answering).

config.label: Optional three
config.description: Optional three.ws API key (bearer token). Not required — the vision endpoint serves anonymous callers on a free per-IP rate limit. Set it to raise your rate limit to the per-user tier. Never needed to access the free model.
